prompt:

Scene: Older adult strolling carefully along park path enjoying surroundings, short relaxed step, no medical disability assumption.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "långsamt = slowly; at a gentle unhurried pace.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Han går långsamt.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
